GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS FOR “M-4" INSTALLATION: 1. Remove shipping cleats located on the bottom of the cabinet. 2. Install (4) provided leg levelers to bottom of cabinet and level cabinet. 3. The power is controlled by a switch located on top of the cabinet. Plug into A.C. only, 115 volts, 60 cycles. In low line areas (115 volts or less) a boost in the output voltage of the transformer may be obtained by removing the wire from the 115 volt top of the trans- former, and rewiring to the 105 volt position. VOLTAGE CONTROL POTS: Located on Power Supply Board (P.C. 0080-00904F) and are preset at the factory. These pots should not be tampered with unless the factor Service Department is contacted. . AMPLIFIER VOLUME CONTROL POTS: Located on Game Logic Board (P.C. A084-90700-C626) and are marked Right Ampl. and Left Ampl. The volume of each amplifier may be varied by rotating pots as desired. METHOD OF PLAY, TIME TEST AND EXTENDED PLAY ADJUSTMENT SWITCHES: Located on Game Logic Board (P.C. A084-90700-6626) and may be adjusted as indicated on separate instruction sheet in back box area. TO SERVICE CONTROL PANEL SWITCHES: 1. Remove Control Panel Cable Jack from Logic Board. 2. Open front Coin Door and release (2) clamps located on each side of cabinet wall thru door opening. 3. Remove wire nut between main cable and Control Panel thru front door opening. 4. Remove Control Panel & Service same. MIDWAY MFG. CO. 10750 W. GRAND AVENUE FRANKLIN PARK, ILLINOIS 60131 PAGE 1
